description:
Dear Team,

Please note that the sensor identified as **device-001** has been configured with two measurable attributes. The first attribute is **temperature**, which should be reported using the template `{{value}} °C` to include the numeric reading followed by the degree‑Celsius symbol. The second attribute is **humidity**, for which the template `{{value}} %` must be applied, appending a percent sign to the measured value. These templates will ensure that all incoming data are formatted consistently across our monitoring platform.
